## [1.4.0](https://github.com/Ikuradachi/Kageroll/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0) (2026-11-13)

### ✨ New Features

* add performance bloat and background service patches ([536107c](https://github.com/Ikuradachi/Kageroll/commit/536107c63d54d2e3e8911a9aac9eb24e911eba10))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* support for v3.129.1, broken disabletelemetry and suppressbloatworkers patch ([ee83706](https://github.com/Ikuradachi/Kageroll/commit/ee837064624fc827ac1d012ae6f696b2247035a5))

patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Removes FLAG_SECURE from membership card and Compose dialogs to permit screenshots and disables Android 14+ screen capture detection in the Arc reader.

patches.name: Disable background services
patches.description: Disables background broadcast receivers, schedulers, widget polling, Firebase session service binding, and DataTransport JobScheduler tasks to eliminate background wakeups and idle battery drain.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Blocks Segment and Mux events, disables periodic telemetry loops and flush timers (Mux 1000ms playback poll, Segment 30s flush, Braze push flush alarms, Datadog upload thread), disables Firebase Analytics after consent updates, denies automatic Crashlytics uploads and selects disabled Datadog setup.

patches.name: Playback speed
patches.description: Unhides the player's speed menu and fills it out to 0.5x-2.0x.

patches.name: Proxy token requests
patches.description: Routes token acquisition and refresh through your SOCKS proxy, with optional proxy authentication.

options.description: Hostname or IP address only, without scheme, credentials, or port. Use brackets for IPv6.
Explicit port from 1 to 65535. Enter as a string when using a JSON options file.
Optional printable ASCII username (1–255 characters). Credentials are embedded in the patched APK. Leave both credential fields blank for no authentication.
Optional printable ASCII password (1–255 characters). Credentials are embedded in the patched APK. Supply both username and password together.
Logs token HTTP status and exception class names only, under MorpheTokenProxy. Enable for troubleshooting.

patches.name: Suppress bloat workers
patches.description: Forces Google Engage, Continue Watching, Datadog, and OneTrust CMP background workers to return success immediately without performing network requests, disk I/O, or image prefetching.
